description: Index of color space definitions in this repo

spaces.name: sRGB
spaces.notes: Standard display space. Nonlinear (gamma-encoded). Do NOT interpolate here.

spaces.name: OKLab
spaces.notes: Best current perceptual space. Use for interpolation, gradients, palette generation.

spaces.name: CIELAB (L*a*b*)
spaces.notes: The OG perceptual space. DeltaE color difference math lives here.

spaces.name: HSL
spaces.notes: Cylindrical sRGB remapping. Harmony algebra uses H channel. Not perceptual.

spaces.name: HSV (HSB)
spaces.notes: Similar to HSL. V=1 gives saturated colors. Common in creative tools.

spaces.name: OKLCh
spaces.notes: Cylindrical OKLab. The best space for creative color work. h for hue rotation, C for chroma, L for brightness — all perceptually uniform.
